note: Pass 1 baseline. Eight formats, loose to strict, one simple and one demanding prompt each. Every name and company is fictional. `expect` is what the run is measured against: words = [min, max] for the main output, items = count asked for, file = a downloadable file was asked for, json = output must parse.

runs.prompt: Brainstorm 10 names for a small ceramics studio's monthly newsletter. Just the list.
Brainstorm 25 ideas to improve 90-day retention for a B2B design-collaboration tool. Group them by effort (low, medium, high) and give one risk for each idea.
Write a short email to my team moving Friday's standup from 9:30am to 10am, starting this week. Under 80 words.

Write a one-page memo (about 400 words) to the leadership team of Northwind Labs, a 40-person software company, proposing a three-month four-day-week pilot. Use these sections: Context, Proposal, Risks, Ask.
Write a 300-word blog post about why we redesigned the onboarding flow for our note-taking app, Fieldnote.
Write a 1,000-word essay titled "The tool shapes the craft" for product designers, with an introduction, three sections with headings, and a conclusion.
Write a short PRD for a "Save as template" button in a document editor: problem, goal, and at most 5 requirements.

Create a full PRD as a downloadable Word document for an offline mode in Fieldnote, a note-taking app. Include problem, goals, non-goals, at least 5 user stories, functional requirements, success metrics, and open questions. About two pages.
Compare Notion, Obsidian and Apple Notes on price, offline support, collaboration and export options, as a table.

Compare five fictional analytics vendors (Acorn, Birch, Cedar, Dune, Ember) on 8 criteria in a table. The data is illustrative, so say so. Add a weighted score column, state the weights, and end with a one-paragraph recommendation.
Make a launch-day checklist for a small SaaS product release, 10 items.

Create a vendor onboarding form as a downloadable document: company details, tax ID, bank details, contact person, services offered, and a signature block. Mark required fields and give each field a type (text, date, number, checkbox).
Create an invoice from Halden Studio to Acme Corp, invoice number HS-104, USD, net 30, with 3 line items: brand workshop $1,200, logo design $2,400, style guide $900.

Create a freelance design services contract template as a Word document, with named placeholders such as {{CLIENT_NAME}} and {{START_DATE}}, and 8 numbered clauses: scope, timeline, fees, payment terms, revisions, intellectual property, confidentiality, termination.
Return JSON only: a list of 3 products, each with id, name, price (a number) and inStock (a boolean).

Return a downloadable .json file containing one example order for a fictional customer. It must validate against this JSON Schema: {"type":"object","required":["order_id","customer","items","status"],"properties":{"order_id":{"type":"string"},"customer":{"type":"object","required":["name","email"],"properties":{"name":{"type":"string"},"email":{"type":"string"}}},"items":{"type":"array","minItems":2,"items":{"type":"object","required":["sku","qty","unit_price"],"properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"},"qty":{"type":"integer"},"unit_price":{"type":"number"}}}},"status":{"enum":["pending","paid","shipped"]}}}
